notes:
Short background:
- Mid-market SaaS: B2B workflow automation platform for operations teams.
- Looking to add an agentic assistant (search + action flows) to their in-app workflow.
- Evaluating Hosted API first for speed to market; wants option to move to Dedicated/VPC for isolation and predictability.

POC summary (2-week hosted POC + internal trial):
- Workload: multi-step agent orchestration (search index -> tool call to CRM -> follow-up action), heavy reliance on streaming and function/tool calling.
- Traffic target: 150-250 concurrent active users for pilot; expect spike up to 500 concurrent during heavy campaigns.
- Latency SLO: first-byte <300-400ms typical, end-to-end streaming responsiveness perceived <1s; p95 token latency target ~400ms.
- Observed during hosted POC (48h synthetic): avg first-byte 320ms, p95 480ms; tool-call timeout rate 1.8% under synthetic load, spikes when parallel tool calls >60/s.
- UX pain: intermittent streaming jitter (UI shows 'blips'), and when tool call times out the assistant returns partial state instead of graceful fallback.

Customer quotes / feedback:
- "We need tool calls to be deterministic — failures can't leak confusing partial actions to our end users" — Jane Kim, CTO.
- Product lead: wants structured tool outputs and clear retry/circuit-breaker semantics.

Technical requirements / preferences:
- Model preferences: prefer open/Redwood-verified models; ability to pin model versions for rollouts.
- Tooling: structured function/tool calling, reliable timeouts/retries, idempotent action semantics.
- Observability: token-level tracing, per-tool call metrics, latency breakdowns for streaming vs tool-call waits.
- Security: SSO/SAML, customer-managed KMS for keys (Dedicated/VPC), audit logging retention 1 year, EU data residency for certain customers.

Engagement timeline / activities:
- 2026-01-11: Intro call (AE + product) — high-level use case and constraints.
- 2026-01-20: Hosted API demo (streaming + tool calls) — SE walkthrough (Samir attended).
- 2026-02-03: 48h hosted POC kickoff (scripted agent flows against staging index) — Fireflies id ff_2026-02-03_meridian_demo_7ab9.
- 2026-02-05: Security questionnaire submitted; asked for SOC2 artifacts and KMS integration notes.
- 2026-02-17: POC results review; raised tool-call reliability and timeout behavior.
- 2026-02-20: Pricing and Dedicated sizing discussion with finance (DEMO follow-up).

Next steps (short):
- Schedule Dedicated sizing walkthrough and cost/throughput sim with infra team (Samir + infra).
- Provide SOC2 readout and KMS integration guide; get legal on DSAs.
- Run targeted POC with Dedicated (2-week burst) to validate tool-call reliability under sustained parallel calls.

Open questions / blockers:
- Need Redwood guidelines on recommended retry/backoff for multi-step agent tool flows.
- Confirm SLA for tool-call latency and expected error modes (fallback semantics).
- Pricing: customer needs a clear Hosted -> Dedicated migration pricing path and break-even analysis.
